title: The Twilight of the Forbidden City
description: In the late Qing Dynasty, eunuch Lai Xi leaves the palace to care for Chojie and Gyeongsaeng, abandoned by Hanmin. The Grand Commander notices him and draws him into a plot to find the imperial seal.

title: The Fantastic Water Babes
description: After losing her boyfriend, Gill, a vengeful girl, joins the Fantastic Water Babes swimming competition against her romantic rival and her friends, even though she doesn't know how to swim. When celebrity swimmer Yuen doesn't follow through on his promise to help her, Gill kidnaps him to make him teach her and her friends how to swim.

title: Overheard
description: Hong Kong cops investigating an insider trading case face temptation when they uncover valuable information.

description: The crew of an airline experiences drama and hijinks across multiple cities in Asia.

description: A woman (Fiona Sit) joins the police force and works with a Japanese Interpol detective (Takuya Suzuki) for her first assignment.

description: A young boy's journey to puberty. Awkward first time experiences are a combination of jest and melancholy as only adolescence can ignite.

title: Sisters in Law
description: Following the caseload of a group of feisty female legal professionals tackling cases from marital violence and kidnapping to child abuse and rape. In the little town of Kumba, Cameroon, there have been no convictions in marital abuse cases for nearly two decades. Thanks to the dynamic and tenacious State Prosecutor Vera Ngassa, Court President Beatrice Ntuba and others, things are about to change.

title: Magic Cop
description: Two police officers react with disbelief to a mystical colleague's claims that a crime spree has a supernatural origin.

title: Ex
description: Zhou Yi is about to leave on holiday with her boyfriend Woody, until an argument makes Zhou Yi to dump him at the airport. Their breakup is being witnessed by her ex-boyfriend.

title: New Blood
description: Alan White (John Hurt) is a desperate man; his daughter must have a heart transplant to live. He gets an unexpected visit from his adult son, Danny (Nick Moran), a criminal who hasn't spoken to his family in years. Danny lost track of a man marked for death and is afraid to face his merciless crime boss. In Danny's plight, Alan sees a way to save both of his children -- already prepared to die in order to donate his heart to his daughter, he will stand in for Danny's escaped hostage.

title: The Odd One Dies
description: Two paid killers (Takeshi Kaneshiro, Carman Lee) gradually fall in love after sharing terrifying adventures tinged with humor.
